messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for service `hosted-inference-prod` (INC-18472). Primary on-call did not ack within 60s. Escalating to secondary and manager. PD link: https://pd.example/INC-18472

incident-bot: Details: high 5xx rate from edge -> backend; error spike started ~2m ago; SLO error rate breached. Auto-notification to secondary (samir) and manager (nora) sent.

jess: saw the spike on dashboard, was about to DM. 5xxs are ~12% on the frontend, latency up ~300ms. Possible load spike from batch job.

mike.h: ok, thanks for flagging. samir, can you ack when you see this? primary timed out? any idea why primary didn't ack?

samir: just saw the PD page, arriving late on my phone (carrier delayed). ack-ing now. starting triage.

samir: quick check: `redwoodctl tail --svc hosted-inference-prod --since 5m --filter "status>=500" | head -n 200` shows repeated KV-cache timeouts and error: `KVCacheTimeout: write failed` from runtime pod inference-34.

ops-bot: autoscaler event at +90s: pool-dedicated scaled +0 (limit reached). Burst capacity exhaustion flagged.

jess: that aligns — requests piling onto hosted instances while dedicated pool is at cap. customer impact: multiple production customers reporting degraded responses, some health checks failing.

nora: manager oncall, on my way. if we can't clear within 10m we should prepare a customer-facing note. product-ops, can you draft the initial blurb?

product-ops: drafting now. proposed: "We're investigating increased error rates affecting hosted inference. Our team is actively mitigating; we'll post updates every 15 minutes." ok to send as interim?

mike.h: yes. also switch traffic routing to fallback model variant in region eu-west-1 to reduce load on failing pods. command: `redwoodctl route set --service hosted-inference-prod --model hosted-lite-v2 --region eu-west-1 --weight 30`

samir: executing routing change now. will monitor errors and token throughput.

samir: routing change applied. early signs: 5xx down to ~6% at edge. continuing to tail logs.

incident-bot: PagerDuty escalation note: secondary ack @3601234802, manager ack @3601234820. Incident status: investigating -> mitigation in progress.

jess: can someone grab a snapshot of slow hosts and open a quick runbook ticket? I can take runbook for KV cache tuning if needed.

mike.h: opening ticket INC-18472-KV with host list and current container restarts. linking here: https://tracker.example/t/INC-18472-KV

nora: good job getting routing change in. once we confirm stable for 20m, we'll close PD page and follow up with a post-incident summary and action items (auto-scaling limits, notify infra about cap).

product-ops: published short status to status.redwood.ai: "Investigating increased error rates for hosted inference; mitigation underway. Next update in 15m."

samir: continuing investigation into KV write failures — looks like a mis-tuned eviction causing lock contention under burst writes. will test KV config rollback in staging then prod if safe. ETA 40m.

jess: adding customer list to the ticket so support can triage incoming reports.

incident-bot: PD note appended: escalation behavior observed due to delayed mobile delivery. Recommend follow-up: verify on-call contact failover and SMS gateway logs.

mike.h: thanks team. keeping thread open; update in 10.
